title: Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)
description:
Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil

Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: May 7, 2026

Closing date: Open until filled

Introduction

Are you interested in how the oil and gas Exploration & Production (E&P) world is transitioning? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?

If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major energy players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.

About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production . The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the upstream oil & gas market. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.

IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore; as such, major industry leaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems using our extensive databases of past project performance.

Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyze technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics

Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics

Skills and Qualities

Project Analysts – Petroleum Exploration & Production must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills; fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments

Travel

  • This position requires up to 30 percent travel; candidates are required to have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays

Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in engineering, science (physics, chemistry, petroleum, geology), statistics, operations research, economics, or related fields
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with upstream oil and gas projects
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data

WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need .

HOW TO APPLY

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior — .NET / Desktop Cross-Platform
description:
Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior — .NET / Desktop Cross-Platform

Híbrido/ Local Barueri

Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos uma pessoa sênior para atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento de um agente desktop corporativo multiplataforma (Windows, macOS, Linux), parte central de uma plataforma SaaS B2B enterprise. O agente roda em larga escala em parques de clientes corporativos, com responsabilidade sobre coleta de telemetria, gestão de endpoint e integrações de produto. A plataforma processa hoje milhões de mensagens por dia , em operação tanto em cloud quanto on-premises nos ambientes dos clientes — e o agente está na ponta que gera boa parte desse volume.

Em paralelo, a pessoa atua na evolução dos serviços de backend em .NET que sustentam a plataforma e participa da migração gradual de serviços legados para a arquitetura .NET atual . Parte desses serviços legados está em Node.js e Python — não esperamos entrega solo nessas stacks, mas esperamos autonomia para ler e executar esse código a fim de entender o comportamento que está sendo migrado.

Procuramos um perfil de engenharia ponta-a-ponta : alguém que pensa em produto, arquitetura, ambiente local, observabilidade, segurança e experiência do desenvolvedor — não apenas no código de uma feature isolada.

Foco da posição

  • Primário — desenvolvimento e evolução do agente desktop em C# / .NET , com paridade entre Windows, macOS e Linux.
  • Secundário — evolução de serviços de backend em .NET (APIs e workers) que se comunicam com o agente e sustentam o backoffice da plataforma.
  • Apoio — leitura e execução de serviços legados em Node.js e Python como parte do trabalho de migração para .NET.

Stack-chave

Onde se espera entrega autônoma

  • C# / .NET — em sistemas reais, em produção
  • Aplicações desktop cross-platform em .NET (Windows, macOS, Linux)
  • APIs REST e integrações
  • Processamento assíncrono e mensageria
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Containers e CI/CD
  • Microsoft Azure como plataforma de cloud

Onde se espera consumidor consciente da plataforma

Não esperamos que essa pessoa seja a dona da plataforma de cloud, do cluster ou da stack de observabilidade. Esperamos autonomia para diagnosticar, operar e tomar boas decisões de design sobre o que afeta o serviço dela:

  • Kubernetes — uso de linha de comando no dia a dia (logs, exec, port-forward, descrição de recursos), leitura de manifests, entendimento dos componentes essenciais. Suficiente para diagnosticar um problema e abrir uma issue precisa para a plataforma.
  • Microsoft Azure — entender as primitivas de cloud usadas pelo serviço (armazenamento, mensageria, gestão de segredos, telemetria) o bastante para tomar boas decisões de design, sem necessidade de provisionar.
  • Observabilidade — raciocínio sistêmico: correlacionar logs, métricas e traces, formular hipótese a partir de evidência, escolher o indicador certo para o problema, saber o que instrumentar e por que . Sem responsabilidade por operar a stack.

Onde se espera ler e executar

  • Node.js — rodar serviços localmente, debugar, entender o fluxo
  • Python — rodar workers e scripts, entender o que está sendo migrado
  • Angular / Ionic — leitura e ajustes pontuais quando o problema cruza fronteira frontend/backend

Responsabilidades

  • Evoluir o agente desktop em produção com foco em estabilidade, segurança, performance e paridade entre sistemas operacionais .
  • Reduzir dívida técnica e elevar o padrão do código.
  • Participar das migrações de serviços legados para a arquitetura .NET atual, com decisões orientadas por contrato e risco — não por reescrita cosmética.
  • Atuar em troubleshooting de produção com método: hipótese, evidência e ação reversível.
  • Apoiar, quando necessário, a análise de chamados de N2 e N3 , com o compromisso de gerar base de conhecimento a cada caso resolvido — de forma que novos acionamentos da mesma natureza sejam tratados nos níveis anteriores e parem de escalar para N3.
  • Conduzir code reviews que ensinam, refinamentos com decomposição clara e documentação útil.
  • Apoiar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores sem virar gargalo.
  • Contribuir para um ambiente local replicável onde qualquer pessoa do time consiga rodar a plataforma inteira sem dor.

Hard skills obrigatórias

Desenvolvimento

  • C# em nível avançado, com base sólida em .NET
  • Experiência com aplicações .NET rodando em mais de um sistema operacional — não apenas Windows
  • APIs REST, integração e processamento assíncrono
  • Concorrência e padrões de resiliência em sistemas distribuídos
  • Mensageria assíncrona e padrões associados (idempotência, dead-letter, ordenação)

Bancos de dados

  • Modelagem relacional e NoSQL
  • Otimização de queries
  • Estratégias de cache

Qualidade

  • Testes unitários e de integração como parte do fluxo, não como tarefa separada
  • Code review como ferramenta de elevação do time
  • Histórico de Git inteligível

Segurança

  • Gestão de segredos
  • Secure coding e OWASP
  • Atenção ao contexto desktop: distribuição assinada, atualização segura e proteção de credenciais locais

Outras stacks (no nível "ler e executar")

  • Capacidade comprovada de ler e rodar Node.js e Python para entender o comportamento de um serviço a ser migrado

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com agentes ou serviços rodando em endpoint do cliente (não apenas servidor)
  • Experiência com frotas distribuídas e telemetria em larga escala
  • Vivência com SaaS multi-tenant
  • Vivência com plataformas enterprise B2B
  • Experiência prévia com migrações de stack sem reescrita big-bang
  • Arquitetura orientada a eventos
  • Uso de IA e code agents no ciclo de desenvolvimento

Soft skills

Buscamos uma pessoa que:

  • Discuta soluções com arquitetos sem ego — defenda posições com dados, mude de ideia diante de argumento melhor.
  • Traduza complexidade técnica para negócio.
  • Colabore real com QA, SRE, UX e produto, sem virar silo.
  • Peça ajuda cedo, compartilhe contexto e evite heroísmo.
  • Tenha ownership : investigue causa raiz e traga proposta junto do diagnóstico.
  • Tenha maturidade sob pressão : em incidente, priorize fato, log e evidência; ação reversível antes de ação heroica.
  • Tenha mentalidade de produto : questione requisitos quando preciso.
  • Tenha humildade técnica : ensine, aprenda, faça code review para elevar pessoas.
  • Tenha pragmatismo : arquitetura que entrega vence arquitetura bonita.

We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.

Qualifications: What you bring to the team

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.

You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

title: Payroll Senior Analyst
description:
Hi there! Thanks for your curiosity

We’re driven by ambition and guided by a bold vision for the years ahead. As we scale our profitable ecosystem of tools and services, we’re seeking a standout Payroll Senior Analyst to help us go to the next level. In this position you will report directly to the Senior Finance Manager .

Who we are

Zubale is a technology company that enables retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of retailers from supermarkets, specialty stores, pharmacies, department stores and fashion brands across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru and Colombia. How? We have three key products:

1) Flexifleet: Freelancer Marketplace to perform picking, packing, and delivery tasks for retailers and aggregators.

2) Fulfillment Optimizer: Modular Software to increase productivity in eCommerce picking, packing and delivery.

3) Consumer Connect: AI WhatsApp Conversational Commerce to boost sales and elevate customer experience.

We are passionate about helping brands, aggregators, and retailers optimize their eCommerce operations, lower costs, and boost profitability. Backed by over $70M USD in venture capital, we’ve delivered consistent growth over the past six years and completed more than 100 million orders through our platform. Today, we serve 100+ customers and engage thousands of freelancers across our network. And this is just the beginning. We're building a profitable, scalable ecosystem — and our vision is to become the #1 partner for retailers to grow their eCommerce business.

Who we are looking for

  1. We are seeking an End-to-End Payroll Owner with an operational, strategic and analytical mindset, capable of executing the payroll operation with full ownership. The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with the ability to collaborate with the Finance and Accounting Team.
  2. We are looking for a leader to implement a new Payroll System and Program in Brazil .

What you will do

  1. End-to-end Payroll (fixed + variable pay).
  2. Salary & Severance: Handling calculations, pay stubs, and legal settlements.
  3. Compliance: Managing social security payments and regulatory filings.
  4. Labor Certifications: Overseeing processes and legal obligations.
  5. Compensation Analysis: Benchmarking roles/shifts for internal pay equity.
  6. Strategic Hiring: Creating plans to boost budget efficiency and cut costs.
  7. Data Insights: Generating payroll reports for leadership decisions.
  8. Process Optimization: Driving continuous improvement in payroll workflows.
  9. Time & Attendance: Tracking and analyzing staff attendance.

The skills and experience you will bring

  1. Solid Experience: 5+ years of end-to-end experience managing complex payroll processes.
  2. Finance Knowledge: General accounting principles.
  3. Leadership: Experience leading teams or large-scale projects.
  4. Resilience: Proven ability to thrive in high-pressure, fast-paced environments.
  5. Critical Thinking: A proactive perspective on problem-solving.
  6. Management: Strong supplier and stakeholder management skills.
  7. Implementation: Experience with payroll system migrations or project implementations.
  8. Tech Savvy: Curiosity and experience with AI and automation tools.
  9. Languages: Professional Working Proficiency in English or Spanish (B2/C1 level). Please note: language skills will be tested during the interview process.

title: Especialista de Software I (Mobile)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como referência técnica em desenvolvimento mobile, contribuindo para a evolução das aplicações da UOL EdTech (OPM) com foco em qualidade, escala e experiência do usuário.
  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura de soluções mobile (modularização, padrões, camadas, offline-first quando aplicável, gestão de dependências, observabilidade e segurança).
  • Projetar e implementar funcionalidades complexas em Flutter, React Native, Android nativo (Kotlin/Java) e iOS nativo (Swift/Obj-C), avaliando trade-offs de cada abordagem.
  • Liderar decisões técnicas sobre estratégia multiplataforma vs nativo, performance, acessibilidade, integração com SDKs e evolução do ciclo de vida dos apps.
  • Conduzir integrações com APIs e serviços, garantindo resiliência (retries, cache, idempotência quando aplicável), e boas práticas de autenticação/autorização.
  • Implantar e evoluir práticas de engenharia: code review, padrões de código, testes automatizados, CI/CD mobile, release management e monitoramento em produção.
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua de performance (startup time, memory, battery, render), estabilidade (crashes/ANRs) e experiência (UX, tracking, analytics).
  • Colaborar com Produto, Design, Dados, Engenharia e Plataforma para definir soluções ponta a ponta e garantir entregas previsíveis.
  • Promover uso prático de IA para acelerar o desenvolvimento e a operação (ex.: automação de testes, análise de crashes/logs, geração de documentação e assistentes internos para troubleshooting).
  • Mentorar pessoas do time, apoiando evolução técnica, boas práticas e cultura de engenharia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com IA aplicada em mobile.
  • Uso de copilots/agentes no fluxo de desenvolvimento.
  • Estratégias para avaliação de código, geração de testes e documentação.
  • Integração com SDKs/APIs de IA (quando aplicável), com foco em privacidade e custo
  • Vivência com arquitetura orientada a módulos, design systems e componentes compartilhados (mobile e/ou cross-plataform).
  • Experiência com observabilidade avançada (ex.: Datadog, Firebase Crashlytics/Performance, Sentry) e definição de SLIs/SLOs para apps.
  • Experiência com integrações de SDKs de terceiros (analytics, antifraude, biometria/prova de vida, pagamentos, deep links, push).
  • Conhecimento de segurança mobile (OWASP Mobile, secure storage, certificate pinning, hardening).
  • Experiência em ambientes multi-produto / multi-squad e apps white-label.

Informações adicionais

Para se destacar nessa posição, seria legal se você também tivesse:

  • Atuação em um ecossistema com múltiplas integrações e alta criticidade de estabilidade, performance e experiência do usuário.

title: PESSOA GERENTE MÉDICA - PESQUISA & DESENVOLVIMENTO
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como referência médica no suporte à definição das indicações terapêuticas de medicamentos em fase de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para as decisões estratégicas do portfólio de novos produtos do grupo de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento, com base em evidências científicas, necessidades clínicas e viabildiade regulatória;
  • Apoia tecnicamente a definição da população-alvo dos estudos clínicos, garantindo que os critérios de inclusão e exclusão estejam alinhados aos objetivos científicos, às necessidades não atendidas e às exigências regulatórias aplicáveis aos desenhos de pesquisa clínica;
  • Identificar, avaliar e recomendar Líderes de Opinião (KOLs) relevantes para os estudos clínicos, considerando expertise científica, experiência clínica, reputação acadêmica e alinhamento ético, de modo a fortalecer a condução dos projetos e a credibilidade científica da companhia;
  • Revisar criticamente os procedimentos médicos descritos nos protocolos de pesquisa clínica, assegurando coerência científica, segurança dos participantes, aderência às Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e alinhamento com as diretrizes médicas e regulatórioas vigentes.
  • Apoiar o relacionamento técnico-científico com os Investigadores Principais e centros de pesquisa, atuando como ponto focal médico para esclarecimentos científicos, alinhamentos e suporte durante as diferentes fases dos estudos clínicos.
  • Contribuir para a análise e acompanhamento da segurança dos participantes de pesquisa, apoiando a avaliação médica de eventos adversos, sinais de segurança e relatórios periódicos, em colaboração com as áreas de farmacovigilância e pesquisa clínica;
  • Dar suporte à definição dos desfechos de eficácia e à construção de claims médicos, assegurando que estejam fundamentados em evidências científicas robustas, resultados clínicos consistentes e em conformidade com os requisitos éticos e regulatórios;
  • Emitir parecer médico sobre benefícios clínicos, lacunas terapêuticas e necessidades m(édicas não atendidas, contribuindo de forma estratégica para a priorização e direcionamento dos projetos de inovçaão e desenvolvimento de novos medicamentos.
  • Revisar, complementar e validar sob a perspectiva médica os relatórios de eficácia e segurança destinados à submissão regulatória junto à ANVISA, garantindo clareza científica, consistência técnica e adquada contextualização clínica dos resutlados apresentados.
  • Prestar suporte médico-científico às demandas relacionadas aos produtos e patologias do portfólio da companhia, por meio do Serviço de Informações Médicas, assegurando respostas técnicas, baseadas em literatura científica atualizada e em conformidade com normas regulatórias.
  • Identificar, desenvolver e fortalecer relacionamentos institucionais com líderes de opinião e stakeholders estratégicos, no contexto de pesquisa clínica, novos produtos, assuntos regulatórios, jurídicos e científicos, com o objetivo de consolidar a imagem da companhia como referência e liderança na indústria famracêutica.
  • Participar das reuniões de discussão de inovação e reuniões de comitê técnico a fim de definir a estratégia médica para registro de novos produtos para empresa.

title: Analista de Engenharia Elétrica Senior - Túneis e Iluminação
description:

title: Professor(a) de Artes Visuais
description:
Position: Visual Arts Teacher

Section: Early Childhood Education (ECE) and Elementary School

Application Deadline: May 15, 2026

Start Date: July 15, 2026

Main responsibilities: Plan, deliver, and develop Visual Arts lessons for Early Childhood and Elementary students, aligned with BNCC, the IB PYP framework, and the school’s pedagogical approach. Promote inquiry-based, creative, and student-centered learning experiences that foster curiosity, imagination, and artistic expression. Design developmentally appropriate learning experiences, exploring a variety of media and techniques such as drawing, painting, collage, and sculpture, encouraging exploration, experimentation, and the development of artistic skills. Support students’ holistic development by fostering cognitive, social, emotional, and creative competencies, while encouraging growing autonomy, reflection, and a sense of identity. Ensure a safe, inclusive, and welcoming learning environment that supports student well-being and confidence to take creative risks. Use formative and observational assessment strategies to monitor and document student progress. Differentiate instruction to meet diverse learning needs in collaboration with the learning support team. Actively contribute to the development of the Arts program through curriculum planning, interdisciplinary projects, exhibitions, and school events, while maintaining effective communication with families.

Requirements: Teaching degree ( Licenciatura ) in Visual Arts. Fluency in English (Portuguese is desirable). Teaching experience, preferably in bilingual or international settings. Ability to work effectively with students from diverse cultural backgrounds. Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Familiarity with educational technology tools and platforms. A Master's degree and IB PYP experience are considered desirable.

About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.

Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.

In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.

Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.

School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.

Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.

A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.

A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

title: Metadata Coordinator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Metadata Coordinator , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will

Data Solutions

  • Manage scientific metadata across internal studies and external published datasets.
  • Curate metadata into structured workbooks, validate it against controlled dictionaries, and upload it into databases.
  • Bridge collaboration between scientists, bioinformaticians, and data engineers to ensure metadata is complete, consistent, and ready for processing.

Data Processing & Pipeline Support

  • Run CLI‑based upload workflows to load curated metadata and processed data into the database.
  • Create and maintain YAML configuration files for study processing.
  • Write SQL queries to validate, troubleshoot, and audit metadata in relational databases.
  • Write shell and Python scripts to automate repetitive metadata tasks.
  • Triage and resolve metadata‑related pipeline failures.

External Data Acquisition

  • Download and process external datasets from public repositories such as NCBI GEO and SRA.
  • Collate metadata from internal clinical data management systems.
  • Prepare metadata workbooks for published studies by extracting key elements from scientific publications.
  • Map external data formats to internal metadata standards.

Cross‑Team Coordination

  • Serve as the main point of contact for metadata requests from scientists and bioinformaticians.
  • Translate scientific requirements into structured metadata, including assay types, sample hierarchies, and study designs.
  • Coordinate with bioinformatics teams on shared vocabularies and pipeline metadata requirements.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong SQL skills, including writing and debugging queries with joins, aggregations, and data validation patterns.
  • Shell scripting experience (Bash), including file manipulation, text processing (awk, sed, grep), and task automation.
  • Python scripting proficiency for data manipulation, file parsing, and integration tasks.
  • Experience working with metadata, ontologies, or controlled vocabularies in a scientific or data management context.
  • Comfort working in a Linux or HPC command‑line environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to enforce data quality standards.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and scientific stakeholders.

Desirable Skills

  • Life sciences background (e.g., genomics, transcriptomics, or other omics domains).
  • Experience with public omics repositories.
  • Familiarity with YAML and JSON configuration or data serialization formats.
  • Database administration or data modeling experience.
  • Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or similar platforms.

title: Gestor(a) Extração
description:

Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Materiais, Química ou afins;

Sólida vivência com extração por moendas e difusores;

Experiência com projetos de triangulação de moendas, bem como metodologias de gestão de processos e melhoria contínua (SDCA, PDCA, Kaizens e etc);

Experiência com gestão de pessoas, processos e custos.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia - SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Chief Commercial Officer
description:
Organização nacional de grande escala, com operação multi-regional e elevada complexidade, atravessa um momento estratégico de qualificação do crescimento, com foco em consistência, previsibilidade e qualidade de decisão. Esse estágio exige elevação do padrão de gestão, maior integração entre estratégia e execução e uso rigoroso de dados como base decisória.

É nesse contexto que buscamos um(a) Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) . A cadeira é central para organizar a agenda comercial, sustentar a execução em múltiplas regiões e modelos de negócio e assegurar decisões ancoradas em disciplina, governança de performance e leitura econômica.

Como CCO, a missão será estruturar e conduzir a estratégia comercial de forma integrada, traduzindo direcionamentos em planos executáveis e decisões bem priorizadas, com liderança madura sobre uma estrutura executiva ampla e impacto direto na previsibilidade de resultados e na sustentabilidade do negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir a agenda estratégica do negócio comercial, conectando leitura aprofundada de mercado, posicionamento competitivo, proposta de valor, pricing e canais;
  • Traduzir direcionamentos estratégicos em planos executáveis, com prioridades claras, sequenciamento lógico e acompanhamento rigoroso;
  • Estabelecer critérios de priorização e alocação de recursos, assegurando foco em um ambiente de alta complexidade;
  • Consolidar a gestão orientada por dados como base das decisões executivas, garantindo qualidade, consistência e leitura crítica dos indicadores;
  • Implantar e sustentar ritos de gestão que assegurem ritmo, disciplina e previsibilidade de resultados;
  • Liderar diretamente uma estrutura executiva ampla, incluindo diretores regionais e frentes corporativas;
  • Desenvolver lideranças, estabelecer padrões de gestão e garantir alinhamento entre estratégia central e execução regional;
  • Atuar como ponto de integração entre frentes corporativas e regionais, assegurando coerência estratégica e clareza decisória;
  • Conduzir decisões comerciais com visão econômica integrada, considerando impactos em capex, opex, margem e retorno;
  • Promover a evolução organizacional por meio da revisão de estruturas, processos e modelos, com postura analítica e investigativa.

Qualificações

  • Trajetória executiva em ambientes complexos, com operações de escala, múltiplas unidades ou atuação multi-regional;
  • Experiência em negócios de serviços, tecnologia, infraestrutura, consumo recorrente ou mercados correlatos, com forte interface entre estratégia e execução;
  • Histórico consistente de liderança de estruturas executivas amplas e responsabilidade direta por decisões e resultados;
  • Forte atuação com dados, inteligência de mercado e métricas de performance como base decisória;
  • Capacidade de estruturar problemas complexos, priorizar iniciativas e sustentar execução disciplinada;
  • Leitura econômica apurada e conforto para tomar decisões com informação incompleta, assumindo responsabilidade por riscos e impactos;
  • Vivência prévia em consultoria estratégica ou atuação equivalente será considerada diferencial relevante.
  • Disponibilidade para residir em São Paulo - SP

title: Senior Supply & Planning Manager - LATAM
description:

Senior Supply & Planning Manager – LATAM

Envu is proud to be Great Place to Work Certified in the U.S., France and India (June 2025 – June 2026)

FUNCTION : Senior Supply & Planning Manager - LATAM

LOCATION : São Paulo/ Brazil

JOB TYPE : Permanent

JOB GRADE : BR15

GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

  • Lead all Regional Demand planning & Supply activity to achieve the business objectives while meeting inventory targets and optimizing total costs of supply in compliance with quality and customer service expectations.
  • Lead regional short-, mid- and long-term demand and supply planning, balance, and execution, providing visibility on supply risks, mitigation plans, and supply opportunities.
  • Manage all materials planning and production planning for all tollers in Latin America, ensuring reliable, safe, and high-quality supply delivered on time.
  • Directly interface with Commercial Operations, Finance, and Regional Leadership to facilitate the monthly Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SI&OP) cycle, ensuring that the information needed for business management is gathered and presented to support decision-making and maximize profitability.

YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

  • Lead the Demand Planning & Supply Team: recruitment, training, expertise, motivation, good practices, People development etc.
  • Integrated planning and decision making | Engage, collaborate and improve cross functional country and Regional SI&OP process, while translating regional sales demands into one integrated commercial-financial-supply plan. Additionally, along with Marketing & Sales, steer product launches, steer product allocations and manage product positioning at distribution. Be responsible for managing the demand forecast flow, optimizing stock levels & inventories and proposing solutions to balance appropriate stock levels and profitability
  • Orchestrate Regional supply planning process | Lead the supply planning process from short to long term, balancing costs and service level, through financial analysis to support decision making. Negotiate manufacturing capacity according to the business needs and optimize cost of goods
  • Demand and Supply Reconciliation | Lead the creation of constrained demand plan, agree and communicate product availability, with transparency and constructive discussions with stakeholders about tradeoffs involved. Work together with the Customer Service, Finance and internal clients such as Marketing and Sales, to generate feasible demand allocation plans for E2E SC coordination.
  • Drive inventory optimization strategies to enhance operational efficiency and reduce excess stock levels. Lead and implement inventory reduction initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure optimal stock availability across the network. Maximize business outcomes by balancing inventory turnover with customer service levels, improving forecast alignment and replenishment decisions. Utilize data-driven insights and advanced analytics to monitor key performance indicators, support scenario-based decision-making, and continuously refine inventory management processes in line with regional strategic goals.
  • Optimize materials and production planning for external manufacturing operations. Developing and implementing efficient planning processes that ensure timely product availability while minimizing costs of goods sold. Collaborate closely with suppliers and manufacturing partners to align production schedules with demand forecasts, facilitating seamless operations and reducing lead times. Continuously assess and refine planning strategies, ensuring that inventory levels are maintained at optimal rates to meet customer needs without incurring unnecessary expenses.
  • Enable business & valuable customers experience I Ensure materials availability according to business & quality needs. Define and negotiate and adjust production priorities to deliver valuable customer experience.
  • SI&OP | Coordinate SI&OP and, performance KPI within the region. Provide necessary information on product availability to the commercial area, enabling best decision making and supply optimizations.

Planning Excellence | Foster planning excellence to optimize and continuously improve planning processes. Demonstrated ability to drive planning excellence through the implementation or optimization of tools such as o9 solutions, improving forecast accuracy and operational efficiency.

ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

  • Degree, on Business Administration, Engineering or equivalent, MBA or Master in Supply chain Management preferred
  • APICS certification is a plus
  • 10 Years cumulative experience in different areas of Supply Chain. Previous experience in Planning / Inventory management
  • Key competencies | Customer Focus, Business Acumen, Strategic and Digital Mindset, Drives Results, Drives Vision & Purpose, Manages Ambiguity
  • Excellent multicultural communication, organization, influencing & coaching skills
  • Excellent knowledge of advanced planning principles, strategies, and systems (MS Dynamics 365 appreciated)
  • Fluent in Portuguese, English and Spanish

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

By applying for this position, you agree that your personal data are going to be processed and recorded by Envu for recruitment purposes only. For candidates who are not selected for this position, personal data will be kept for a period of two years and then permanently deleted.

title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

title: Coordenador de Inteligência Antifraude (Patrimonial)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Security Services para liderar e estruturar serviços especializados de segurança corporativa/ inteligência antifraude, atuando de forma estratégica na coordenação de equipes, consultorias, análises de riscos e proteção de ativos para diferentes clientes.

Essa posição combina atuação técnica, liderança de pessoas e visão sistêmica de processos de segurança e inteligência Antifraude.

Conheça nossa história:

A nossa história começa em 1994, na Argentina, quando a GIF se estabeleceu como fornecedora estratégica para empresas. Na mesma época, houve uma expansão comercial significativa, que foi acompanhada por um aumento de casos de fraudes. Foi nesse momento que a assumimos a responsabilidade de garantir a segurança das empresas e entramos em ação.

Ao longo desses quase 30 anos, a GIF tem trabalhado incansavelmente na prevenção, detecção e combate às fraudes corporativas. Uma história marcada por confiança, dedicação, colaboração, transparência e respeito.

  • Planejar, acompanhar e desenvolver o time, promovendo treinamentos e integração;

  • Liderar projetos de inteligência antifraude e segurança corporativa;
  • Integração de tecnologias de segurança eletrônica;
  • Gerir crises de security e safety;

title: Support Consultant - SAP SD ABAP
description:
As an Support Consultant Specializing in SAP SD, you will focus on supporting, analyzing, and improving our highly customized SAP landscape. You will work closely with international stakeholders to ensure efficient issue resolution and continuous improvement of SAP SD processes across the organization.

  • Provide second-level SAP support in the SD module to Würth Group companies on a global scale
  • Analyze and resolve incidents and service requests in a structured and solution-oriented manner

  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional solution concepts in SAP SD

  • Document, test, and validate processes, system functionalities, and solutions

  • Maintain and support e-catalog (e-cat) processes, including customizing for branch setup and creation of new company codes

  • Deliver user support and knowledge transfer to improve system usage and user experience
  • Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to travel when required

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in SAP, with a focus on the SD module
  • Solid understanding of SAP SD processes and customizing
  • Basic to intermediate ABAP knowledge, especially for debugging and analysis
  • Experience in SAP support environments
  • Familiarity with highly customized SAP landscapes is a strong advantage
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills

title: Cloud Platform Engineer Sr
description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.

Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Cloud Platform Engineer , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.

Atuação na região Central - Polo CTO no modelo hibrido

Nessa função você vai:

No Itaú, as plataformas de IA e GenAI já operam em escala real, suportando modelos fundacionais, agentes autônomos, pipelines de inferência e workloads intensivos em computação.

O grande desafio da nossa squad é claro:

Reduzir o Time-to-Market de projetos de Dados, IA e Inovação, garantindo plataformas cloud robustas, seguras, eficientes e automatizadas, prontas para suportar alta demanda de compute, dados sensíveis e integrações complexas.

Essa vaga é para quem quer atuar no core da engenharia de plataformas de IA construindo a infraestrutura que viabiliza LLMs, agentes e RAG em produção com confiabilidade, observabilidade e controle de custos.

Ser a pessoa engenheira responsável por habilitar os recursos necessários para provisionamento de plataformas de IA, como recursos e serviços em Cloud garantindo que times de produto consigam colocar soluções de IA em produção com velocidade e segurança.

Aqui, cloud não é apenas infraestrutura. É plataforma de aceleração de IA.

Como Cloud é tratado aqui / Cloud não é tratado como:

  • Provisionamento manual
  • Ambientes isolados por projeto
  • Infraestrutura estática
  • Cloud aqui é:
  • Padronizada e reutilizável
  • Infraestrutura como codigo, desde o design
  • Base para workloads de IA escaláveis e observáveis
  • Fundamento para custo eficiente em compute intensivo

O que você vai construir

  • Plataformas cloud para IA e GenAI, suportando:
  • LLMs, agentes autônomos, RAG e pipelines de inferência
  • Ambientes de treino, experimentação e produção
  • Arquiteturas cloud escaláveis e resilientes, cobrindo:
  • AWS, Azure e/ou GCP
  • Ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud
  • Ambientes containerizados e orquestrados:
  • Docker e Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE)
  • oIngress controllers, service mesh e load balancing L4/L7
  • Infraestrutura como Codigo (IaC):
  • Terraform e CloudFormation
  • Padrões reutilizáveis e versionados
  • Pipelines CI/CD e automação:
  • Deploy de aplicações, modelos e infra
  • Integração com fluxos de MLOps / AIOps
  • Observabilidade completa de plataformas de IA:
  • Monitoramento, logging, tracing
  • Troubleshooting de workloads distribuídos
  • Otimização de custos em IA (FinOps):
  • Compute intensivo (GPU/CPU)
  • Dimensionamento eficiente para treino e inferência
  • Networking cloud avançado:
  • VPC/VNet, subnets, routing e DNS
  • Load Balancers, ingress e service exposure
  • Conectividade híbrida (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute)

Perfil que buscamos

  • Já construiu ou operou plataformas cloud em ambientes críticos
  • Entende que IA exige infra diferente de sistemas tradicionais
  • Gosta de trabalhar com segurança, automação, padrão e escala
  • Consegue equilibrar:
  • Performance
  • Confiabilidade
  • Custo
  • Tem visão de cloud como produto de plataforma, não apenas como ambiente

Conhecimentos essenciais

  • IA e GenAI:
  • LLMs, agentes, RAG
  • Entendimento do ciclo de vida de IA: dados ¿ treino ¿ modelos ¿ inferência
  • Plataformas Cloud:
  • AWS, Azure e/ou GCP
  • Containers e orquestração:
  • Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infraestrutura como Cdigo:
  • Terraform, CloudFormation
  • CI/CD e automação
  • Observabilidade e troubleshooting
  • FinOps e otimização de custo em compute intensivo
  • Networking cloud e conectividade híbrida:
  • VPC/VNet, DNS, routing
  • Load balancers L4/L7, ingress controllers
  • VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute

Por que essa vaga é estratégica

  • Você vai habilitar IA em escala, não s subir infraestrutura
  • Seu trabalho reduz lead time, não s incidentes
  • Cloud tratado como plataforma e acelerador de inovação
  • Atuação em problemas reais de IA em produção, não apenas POCs

Ao se tornar um ituber você tem_

  • Vale-Transporte
  • Vale-Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale-Alimentação (Supermercados)
  • Plano médico (Fundação Saúde Itaú ou Central Nacional Unimed)

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Piece

Piece is a holding company that acquires vertical software/AI businesses and scales them through creator-powered distribution. We believe the next Latin American giants will emerge at the intersection of AI and creator economy — software brings technology, recurring revenue, and LTV; creators bring audience, trust, and distribution. Piece brings them together.

Our edge is a proprietary creator-focused distribution engine that uses AI to automate growth across our vertical software portfolio — social media, sales funnels, content, and creator operations. Every vertical we add makes the machine smarter, compounding proprietary data on what works in creator-led distribution for AI/Software. Our goal is to hit US$10M ARR in 2026.

We're building Piece to be a home for some of the most exceptional people in the world. Talent density is non-negotiable, the bar is unreasonably high, and we expect excellence in everything we ship. Our ambition is to put Brazil on the map as a global protagonist in growth and distribution.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to be the technical pillar of the product at the first and main company in our portfolio — someone who combines technical depth with product sense, and who will own the architecture, evolution, and operation of its entire backend and AI infrastructure.

You'll be hands-on building and scaling the systems that orchestrate our agents, process messages in real time, and sustain the platform's accelerated growth. This isn't a maintenance role — it's a building role.

If you enjoy solving complex problems in distributed systems, have a genuine interest in applied AI, and want to build something that's reshaping how the Brazilian legal market operates, this is the place. You'll join as part of our founding team, with competitive compensation and meaningful equity through stock options.

What you'll do

Backend architecture and evolution

  • Design and evolve the microservices that power the platform, with a focus on scalability and maintainability
  • Make technical decisions autonomously — database modeling, API design, stack choices
  • Raise the team's technical bar through code review and mentorship

AI agents and LLMs

  • Build and evolve our agent pipelines: orchestration, tool calling, dynamic workflows, and intelligent routing
  • Optimize cost and latency of LLM calls without compromising quality
  • Evolve our RAG, document processing, and voice synthesis features

Integrations and operations

  • Ensure reliability of asynchronous message flows and external integrations
  • Build new integrations as the product evolves

Quality and observability

  • Ensure end-to-end traceability across synchronous and asynchronous flows
  • Structure operational metrics and maintain visibility over agent behavior in production
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks before they become incidents

What we expect from you

Backend & Systems

  • Proficiency with Node.js + TypeScript in high-throughput production systems — including API design, modular architecture, and long-term maintainability decisions
  • Strong grasp of event-driven and asynchronous architectures: message queues, pub/sub patterns, idempotency, retry logic, and failure isolation in distributed systems
  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS backends: data isolation strategies, per-tenant configuration, and operational complexity at scale
  • Solid database modeling — relational (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and NoSQL (document modeling, consistency trade-offs) — and ability to choose the right store for the problem
  • Hands-on cloud experience (GCP preferred): Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore/Cloud SQL, IAM, and observability tooling

AI & Agent Systems

  • Experience building LLM-powered pipelines in production — not just calling APIs, but thinking through orchestration, context management, fallback behavior, and output reliability
  • Understanding of agent architectures: tool calling, multi-step reasoning, routing logic, state management across turns, and how to make agents predictable in real-world conditions
  • Practical knowledge of RAG pipelines: chunking strategies, embedding selection, retrieval quality, and reranking — and awareness of where RAG breaks down
  • Cost and latency awareness in LLM usage: prompt engineering for efficiency, model selection trade-offs, caching strategies, and when not to use an LLM
  • Familiarity with evaluation and observability for AI systems: how to measure agent quality, detect regressions, and maintain visibility over non-deterministic behavior in production

Product & Technical Judgment

  • Ability to reason about product trade-offs, not just technical ones — understands what to build, what to cut, and why
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity: capable of going from a fuzzy problem to a concrete technical proposal without needing a fully-specced ticket
  • Has opinions about prioritization and isn't just an executor — questions requirements upstream and thinks about user and business impact before writing the first line of code
  • Uses AI tools natively in the development workflow (coding assistants, automated testing, code review, documentation) and stays current with the evolving tooling landscape. Understands that development velocity is a competitive advantage, not just an output metric

Quality & Operational Maturity

  • Ability to instrument distributed systems end-to-end: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and SLO thinking
  • Experience operating asynchronous flows with real customers: understanding of what breaks silently and how to catch it before they do
  • Comfort with ambiguity — able to define the right technical approach when the problem itself is still being figured out

Nice to have

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time

Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.

About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.

The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.

This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment

What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking

Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)

Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy

Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

title: Product Designer
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

At Busbud, we connect millions of travelers with buses, coaches, and trains across 80+ countries. Design is how we make that feel effortless.

As a Product Designer, you’ll sit at the intersection of design, technology, and business, turning complex ideas into intuitive, well-crafted experiences that solve real problems for real people. You won’t just be designing the experience; you’ll be an active partner in defining it. You’ll focus on consolidating and elevating our web experience across our family of brands (Busbud, Buson, Recorrido, and more), working in a tight-knit team of two designers and reporting to the Lead Product Designer.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • End-to-End Ownership: Drive the full design lifecycle, from early-stage exploration and concept development to final hand-off and implementation.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to define problems, translate business goals into design solutions, and ensure technical feasibility.
  • Craft & Execution: Leverage our robust design system to move directly from concept to high-fidelity execution, bypassing low-fidelity wireframing to prioritize speed and visual precision.
  • Iterative Design: Use data, user research, and performance metrics to continuously refine the product, moving fluidly between exploration and execution.
  • System Thinking: Contribute to and evolve our design systems to ensure a scalable, consistent, and efficient experience across the entire product.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Foundational Excellence: 5+ years of experience in product or UX design, with a portfolio that demonstrates the ability to simplify complex problems with strong visual craft.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in cross-functional environments where you can communicate design decisions and storytell the vision to engineers, PMs, and leadership.
  • Technical Proficiency: Mastery of Figma and a solid understanding of scalable design practices, with fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Quality & Autonomy: An obsessive attention to detail and the ability to own your time and priorities without hand-holding. We don’t believe in micromanagement.

Additional Assets

  • Experience with design systems and multi-brand product families.
  • Visual or graphic design skills.
  • Basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS).
  • Motion design or micro-interaction experience.

THE IMPACT YOU’LL HAVE

Your work will directly influence the daily experience of millions of travelers, driving satisfaction and overall product success. By balancing user empathy with business objectives, you’ll help us build products that are both meaningful and highly functional.

  • Intuitive solutions that align with user needs and ship on time.
  • A maintainable, scalable design system that empowers the whole team.
  • Consistent, high-quality experiences that support our long-term business goals.

• Você quer executar dentro de um padrão visual já definido, com agilidade e atenção a detalhes e não esteja procurando posição para liderar direção criativa ou comandar equipe.

• Você é designer gráfico aplicado a marketing, com experiência em criação de peças de redes sociais, e-books, apresentações comerciais e não está em transição para UX/UI ou Product Design.

• Você domina as ferramentas certas para cada entrega, sem fanatismo. Se você acredita que "ferramenta X é a única séria" e não usa o resto, você vai se frustar aqui.

• Você tem ao menos 1 ano de experiência efetiva (CLT ou PJ) como designer ou ainda fez um estágio único de 12+ meses contínuos com responsabilidades reais. Aqui você vai aplicar o que já sabe;

• Sua estética é corporativa, institucional, sóbria. Se seu portfólio mostra cuidado com hierarquia, clareza e linguagem visual profissional, vai casar bem.

O que você vai fazer
  • Produção diária de peças gráficas para uma carteira de clientes (escritórios de advocacia). O trabalho é volume com qualidade dentro de padrão.
  • Peças para redes sociais (50% do tempo). Posts, stories, carrosséis e capas para LinkedIn (principal canal B2B jurídico) e Instagram. Você adapta a partir de templates e diretrizes visuais já definidas para cada cliente. Não é criação do zero o tempo todo. É execução inteligente dentro de um padrão.
  • Diagramação de materiais (30% do tempo). E-books de 30+ páginas, apresentações comerciais, propostas, newsletters, relatórios e materiais institucionais. Conteúdo chega pronto ou semi-pronto. Seu papel é transformar texto denso em layouts limpos. Clareza e ritmo de leitura importam mais do que efeito visual.
  • Adaptações e desdobramentos (15% do tempo). Adaptar peças entre formatos e plataformas, ajustar materiais existentes, criar variações a partir de um key visual aprovado.
  • Organização de arquivos (5% do tempo). Manter pastas organizadas, nomear arquivos corretamente, respeitar padrões de entrega. Parte do método.
Stack esperada
  • Base sólida: Photoshop e Illustrator em nível intermediário a avançado (tratamento de imagem, vetorização, ajustes finos).
  • Produção ágil: familiaridade com ferramentas de criação rápida para volume de social e materiais simples (Canva Pro, Figma ou equivalentes).
  • Apresentações: PowerPoint ou Google Slides para institucional e comercial.
  • Diferencial real: InDesign para diagramação editorial densa, motion (After Effects, CapCut), IA generativa aplicada a design, experiência prévia em mercado jurídico, financeiro ou serviços profissionais.
Requisitos não negociáveis

1 a 5 anos de experiência efetiva (CLT ou PJ) como designer gráfico

• Portfólio acessível (link de Behance, Dribbble, site pessoal ou PDF)

• Capacidade de trabalhar com volume, múltiplos clientes e prazos curtos sem perder qualidade

• Atenção a detalhes: revisão de textos nas peças, alinhamentos, consistência entre formatos

• Disponibilidade para híbrido em SP (presencial 3x/semana na região do Paraíso)

• Aceita contratação PJ

Processo seletivo

Triagem por currículo + portfólio · Entrevista · Teste prático visual · Conversa final.

O que oferecemos

• Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado

• Modelo híbrido (presencial em SP, 3x por semana + remoto)

• Autonomia real: você terá clientes e entregas sob sua responsabilidade

• Exposição a um nicho de alta complexidade e alto valor — negócios jurídicos é um mercado que você dificilmente encontra em outro lugar

• Espaço para crescer. Quem entra e entrega, evolui rápido.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred

Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.

As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

  • Elaboração de modelos financeiros.

Requisitos:
